pixelate-images/how_to_use/apply_pixelat: The selected area will be pixelated immediately. Repeat to add more pixelated areas.
pixelate-images/how_to_use/clear_pixelat: Click the eraser button to remove all pixelations from the current image.
pixelate-images/how_to_use/download_desc: Click the download button to save the pixelated image. Each image can be downloaded independently.
pixelate-images/how_to_use/select_tool_d: Choose from three tools in the toolbar:
pixelate-images/how_to_use/tool_brush_de: Click and drag to paint pixelation with a brush. Adjust brush size using the input number control (hold + or - for continuous adjustment).
pixelate-images/how_to_use/tool_circle_d: Click and drag to draw elliptical areas. Hold Shift to draw perfect circles.
pixelate-images/how_to_use/tool_square_d: Click and drag to draw rectangular areas. Hold Shift to draw perfect squares.
pixelate-images/how_to_use/upload_images: Drag and drop or click to upload one or more images. Each image will have its own independent editor.
pixelate-images/note: Apply mosaic or pixelation effects to multiple images using square, circle, or brush tools. Each image has its own independent editor.
pixelate-images/tags: image, pixelate, mosaic, privacy, local, browser, editor, effect, censor, batch
pixelate-images/tips/brush_size: Use the brush size control for precise pixelation control.
pixelate-images/tips/shift_key: Hold Shift while drawing squares or circles to maintain aspect ratio.
pixelate-images/tips/undo: Use the eraser button to clear all pixelations and start over.
